content:
This little PDF was created using @Luke Boswell's great roc-pdf: record-sale.pdf :tada:

It's a flyer that realtors put up after selling a property when they hit a sales record. Previously they would create them manually in InDesign, but withroc-pdf they're now automatically generated :) roc-pdf let me put two A5s next to each other on a landscape A4, have embedded fonts, and was a pleasure to work with! Thanks Luke!
Love to see it. Let me know if you find any rough edges.
wow that is a nice pdf! I can't wait until I have some documents to generate!
